items.raw_excerpt: Evento gratuito terá apresentações musicais na Praça Charles Miller, em frente ao estádio Pacaembu
items.summary_en: A free food festival will be held on Saturday at Charles Miller Square, in front of the Pacaembu stadium. Visitors can enjoy dishes from 60 countries. The event will also include musical performances.
items.summary_ko: 무료 음식 축제가 토요일 파카엠부 경기장 앞 샤를 밀레르 광장에서 열립니다. 방문객들은 60개국의 다양한 요리를 맛볼 수 있습니다. 이번 행사에는 음악 공연도 함께 준비되어 있습니다.
items.title_en: Food festival brings cuisines of 60 countries to Sao Paulo this Saturday

items.raw_excerpt: Έπειτα από την μερική βελτίωση των καιρικών συνθηκών
items.summary_en: Weather conditions have partly improved in Greece. Ferry services are returning to normal, and ship schedules are running again as usual.

items.raw_excerpt: If you’ve yet to check out a natural wonder in Ontario this summer, this more than 40-metre-tall waterfall is likely calling your name. Here’s what to know about Kakabeka Falls.
items.summary_en: Kakabeka Falls is more than 40 metres tall. It is the second tallest waterfall in Ontario. The waterfall sits in a small rural village with a population of about 100.
items.summary_ko: 카카베카 폭포는 높이가 40미터가 넘습니다. 온타리오에서 두 번째로 높은 폭포이며, 인구 약 100명의 작은 시골 마을에 자리 잡고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Ontario's 2nd tallest waterfall hides in a village of 100 people
items.title_ko: 온타리오에서 두 번째로 높은 폭포, 인구 100명의 작은 마을에 있다
items.title_original: Ontario’s 2nd tallest waterfall is tucked inside a charming, rural village with a population of 100 - St. Catharines Standard

items.raw_excerpt: Government confirms ongoing digital land resurvey, plans to revamp contract staff and enhance efficiency with permanent surveyors.
items.summary_en: The state government said the ongoing digital land resurvey will not be stopped. It plans to replace contract staff with permanent surveyors to work more efficiently.
items.summary_ko: 주 정부는 진행 중인 디지털 토지 재측량을 중단하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 계약직 인력을 정규 측량사로 전환해 효율을 높이겠다는 계획이다.
items.title_en: Kerala government says digital land resurvey will continue
items.title_original: Digital land resurvey will continue, says government

items.raw_excerpt: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But there's a catch.
items.summary_en: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But there is a catch. This week the quiz tests your knowledge of Get Smart, Snoopy and a classic song about piña coladas.
items.summary_ko: ABC 5050 퀴즈의 모든 문제에는 정답 하나와 오답 하나, 딱 두 개의 선택지가 있다. 하지만 그 속에는 함정이 숨어 있다. 이번 주는 겟 스마트, 스누피, 그리고 피나콜라다 노래에 대한 상식을 시험한다.

items.raw_excerpt: In 1928, Balaklava school teacher Jeanne Day set her eyes on a Finnish tall ship docked at Port Lincoln and decided to disguise herself as a boy for the voyage of a lifetime.
items.summary_en: In 1928, a school teacher from Balaklava saw a Finnish tall ship docked at Port Lincoln. She disguised herself as a boy and stowed away for a voyage of a lifetime.
items.summary_ko: 1928년, 발라클라바의 학교 선생님이 포트링컨에 정박한 핀란드 범선을 보고 소년으로 위장해 무임승선했습니다. 평생 잊지 못할 항해를 떠났습니다.
items.title_en: Stowaway school teacher who disguised herself as a boy on a tall ship
items.title_original: Stowaway school teacher who disguised herself as a boy on a tall ship

items.raw_excerpt: Porfirian-era Mexico ended with the Mexican Revolution, but while it lasted it produced iconic architecture that still stands in Mexico City.
items.summary_en: Porfirian-era Mexico ended with the Mexican Revolution. But while it lasted, it produced iconic architecture. Many of those buildings still stand in Mexico City today.
items.summary_ko: 포르피리아 시대 멕시코는 멕시코 혁명으로 막을 내렸습니다. 하지만 그 시절 세워진 상징적인 건축물들이 오늘날 멕시코시티에 그대로 남아 있습니다.
items.title_en: Porfirian buildings still stand in Mexico City

items.raw_excerpt: Programação de encerramento terá a entrega do Prêmio Leonard Rieser para jovens cientistas, seguida de conferência da historiadora Camila Perochena, em formato virtual.
items.summary_en: A science group in Brazil is holding a Family Day in Science this Saturday. The closing program will give the Leonard Rieser Prize to young scientists. A historian will then give an online talk.
